name: Otome Kokoro
source:
[b]A Maiden Longing for an Ideal Love[/b]

Grade: Second-year/internal student, women's basketball club​ member

Boldly changes her image to make her co-educational school debut, a fairy tale maiden who dreams of meeting a destined prince riding a white horse. However, all of those are destroyed by [url=/c128223]Kanata[/url], and they end up having a feud every time they see each other. While she is feeling heartbroken due to the different reality from what she had expected, she is still a maiden longing for love and cannot easily give up her ideal. Despite being bad at it, she is enthusiastic about her club activities, even though she has no sense of fashion at all, she is trying hard to be fashionable. While the results may not come easily, her friends completely appreciate her merits.

"My charming prince on a white horse────Only the horse came though."

[Translated and edited from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1232470]Getchu[/url]]
